params.prompt: Isometric 3D illustration in soft matte clay style, clean studio lighting on a light grey background. A big stack of tax declaration papers and bank statements with tidy tables of numbers, one sheet unfolded like a giant floor. Tiny friendly accountant characters in business clothes check every number: two hold large magnifying glasses over digits, one climbs a ladder along a column of figures, two drag a giant highlighter leaving a turquoise #30D5C8 marker stroke under a total, one ticks checkboxes on a clipboard, one waves a small flag on a checked row. Calm, careful, reassuring mood, premium and minimal, graphite #11141B outlines and details, turquoise as the only accent, lots of empty light space on the left third for a headline. No logos, no readable brand names.
